description: This source file contains the implementation of the OrderProductDownloadService interface, specifically the OrderProductDownloadServiceImpl class. It manages order product download operations in an e-commerce application, including retrieving download data by order ID. The class uses Spring annotations for dependency injection and extends a generic service class.
